text:
Maya: FYI incoming ticket from Kestrel.ai — they completed SSO + onboarding but can't find the API key in the console. Ticket #SUP-4821. Customer says they see the project but no keys listed.

Kestrel SRE: hey team, just finished the Okta flow. Console shows project 'kestrel-prod' but under API keys it's empty. We tried to click 'Create key' and it gives a 500. Need urgent access for our CI.

Evan: pinging @raj and @alex — this smells like the provisioning webhook not binding the key to the new project during SSO provision. Do we have recent flaps in the provisioning service? :eyes:

Raj: seeing errors in the provisioning logs around 2026-02-28T15:12Z for that org id. Looks like the background job created an API key object but the project link step errored: `FK constraint fails: project_id NULL`. Full stack snippets attached in internal logs.

Alex: can you paste the exact response the console got when the customer clicked 'Create key'? Also ask them to try the direct admin API repro:
```
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/admin/v1/keys" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"org_id":"org_8Kestrel","project_id":"proj_kestrel_prod","label":"cli-temp"}'
```

Kestrel SRE: we don't have an admin token — that's why we used the console. But here's the console error they saw (screenshot pasted): `500 InternalError: failed to attach key -> project (code: KEY_BIND_FAIL)`.

Maya: I'm going to escalate to eng-infra with the repro steps and the customer's org_id. @raj any chance we can surface keys that were orphaned (created without project link) so we can rebind them?

Raj: yes, we have an orphaned_keys table in the infra DB where the background job writes failed binds. I'll run a safe query to list keys for `org_8Kestrel` and return candidate key ids. I won't rebind without approval.

devops-bot: Automated probe: provisioning-service health = OK, last deploy = 2026-02-27T23:40Z, queue backlog = 0.

Evan: thanks. @kestrel_sre — can you confirm the org_id shown in the console (bottom-left) is `org_8Kestrel` and the project slug is `kestrel-prod`? Also, any browser extensions or adblockers? (past bugs with console JS failing to render keys list)

Kestrel SRE: org_id confirmed `org_8Kestrel`. Project slug `kestrel-prod`. No weird extensions. They saw the 500 each time they tried to create a key.

Raj: okay running the read-only check now. (internal) SQL: `SELECT id, label, created_at, bind_error FROM keys WHERE org_id='org_8Kestrel' AND project_id IS NULL;`

Raj: result: one row -> id `key_3Yx7`, label `onboard-default`, created_at `2026-02-28T15:11:53Z`, bind_error `FK project_id NULL at step attach_project`.

Alex: if we confirm that's the customer's key we can rebind with the admin API:
```
PATCH https://api.redwood.ai/admin/v1/keys/key_3Yx7
Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN
Body: { "project_id": "proj_kestrel_prod" }
```
Need a minute to prepare an audit-safe rebind flow (recording, approval, rotate keys).

Maya: customer agreed to a rotate after we rebind. We should also check why the console Create Key button returns 500. Could be an unhandled exception when the background job marks the key as bound too quickly. @raj please add a retry on FK failure and surface a clearer message on the UI.

Raj: noted — I'll add a guard in provisioning to delay marking created=true until the transaction completes, and add a `bind_error` field surfaced in the UI list. I'll open a PR and link it here.

Evan: action items: 1) Rebind orphan key after engineering confirms 2) Rotate key and hand it to customer via secure channel 3) Patch provisioning to avoid FK race and add clearer console error 4) Follow up with SRE postmortem.

Alex: suggested admin rebind workflow (for audit) — create a one-time admin action record, execute rebind, rotate old key (if already seen in logs), attach audit_id to key. I'll draft the steps and ping legal if needed.

Maya: For immediate unblock, can we issue a temporary scoped key (inference-only) while we fix? Customer CI only needs inference for 2 hours.

Raj: yes we can create a temp key manually and scope it. Creating with `project_id` blank so not to touch their project list: `key_temp_Tz` scope: `inference:read` expiry `2h`. Will hand to @maya for secure delivery.

devops-bot: Security note: creating temporary keys must be logged. Generated key id `key_temp_Tz`; no plaintext stored in logs.

Maya: delivered the temp key to the customer's secure contact via 2FA link. They confirmed CI got green on their side. :tada:

Kestrel SRE: CI job passed, thanks everyone. Please keep us posted on the permanent key rebind and fix.

Raj: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/provisioning/pulls/451 — adds retry+transaction fix, surfaces bind_error to API. Will schedule a canary deploy after review.

Alex: After rebind + rotate, I'll verify console shows keys and add a small e2e test to catch this flow.

Maya: marking this thread as in-progress. Will update when rebind + rotate done.

Evan: Great job team. Closing loop when PR is deployed and customer confirms permanent key works.

(THREAD END)"
